words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.tr: 倒垃圾：将垃圾从室内搬到室外的行为，通常是将垃圾放入垃圾桶或垃圾袋中，以便进行垃圾处理。
words.ex: He takes out the rubbish every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上倒垃圾。
words.en: To remove the garbage from inside a building to the outside, typically to a designated area for collection.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上扫地。
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的房间在三楼。
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.ex: He throw the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: To propel something through the air with a movement of the arm and hand.

words.ex: He is talking all the time.
words.ex_cn: 他一直在说话。
words.en: If something happens or is done all the time, it happens or is done continually or repeatedly.

words.tr:
adv. 两者都不；
adj. 两者都不的；
conj. 也不；
pron. 两者都不；
words.ex: I don't like coffee, and neither do I like tea.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡，也不喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a further negative statement after a negative one, or to indicate that a negative statement is also true of another person or thing

words.ex: He wears a white shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件白衬衫去上班。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing for the upper body, typically having a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.ex: He will call me as soon as he arrives.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给我打电话。
words.en: At the moment that; immediately after.

words.tr:
v. 通过；传递；路过；(时间)流逝；
n. 通行证；(考试)及格；
words.ex: He passed the exam with a high score.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: To move or go past someone or something; to transfer or hand over something to someone.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.ex: Can you lend me your pen?
words.ex_cn: 你能把你的笔借给我吗？
words.en: If you lend something you own to someone else, you allow them to have it or use it for a period of time, after which they must return it to you.

words.ex: He hurt his finger while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在做饭时弄伤了手指。
words.en: One of the five long parts at the end of your hand, including your thumb.

words.ex: I hate waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: To hate someone or something means to feel intense or passionate dislike for them.

words.tr: n. 令人讨厌的或繁重的工作；
words.ex: Washing dishes is a boring chore.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗是一件烦人的琐事。
words.en: A chore is a task or piece of work that is often boring or unpleasant but needs to be done regularly.

words.tr:
conj. 当…的时候；尽管；然而；
n. 一段时间；一会儿；
words.ex: I read a book while I waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我等公交车的时候读了一本书。
words.en: While is used to introduce a clause in which you mention something that happens at the same time as something else, or to introduce a clause that contrasts with something else that you have mentioned.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.ex: Children depend on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: The country gained independence in 1960.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在1960年获得了独立。
words.en: Independence is the freedom from control or influence of others, allowing one to make decisions and act on one's own.

words.ex: The teacher showed fairness in grading all students.
words.ex_cn: 老师在给所有学生评分时展现了公平。
words.en: Fairness is the quality of treating people equally or in a way that is right or reasonable.

words.tr:
prep. 自…以后；从…以来；
conj. 因为；由于；既然；从…以后；
adv. 此后；后来；
words.ex: He has lived here since 2020.
words.ex_cn: 他自2020年以来一直住在这里。
words.en: From a past time until now; because; as a result of the fact that.

words.ex: My neighbor gives me apples from her tree.
words.ex_cn: 我的邻居从她的树上给我摘苹果。
words.en: A neighbor is someone who lives near you, or a country that is next to another country.

words.tr: phrase. 照顾；照料；处理；应付
words.ex: She takes care of her little brother after school.
words.ex_cn: 她放学后照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To look after someone or something; to deal with something.

words.tr: adj. 生病的；坏的；不舒服的；
words.ex: He is ill and cannot go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他生病了，不能去上学。
words.en: If you are ill, you are suffering from a disease or a health problem.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.tr:
adj. 公平的；相当大的；合理的；
n. 集市；
words.ex: The teacher gave a fair grade to every student.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生都给了一个公平的分数。
words.en: Fair means treating people equally without favouritism or discrimination.

words.tr: adj. 不公正的；不公平的；
words.ex: The teacher gave an unfair test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个不公正的考试。
words.en: If you describe a situation or action as unfair, you mean that it is not right or reasonable, especially because it does not treat people equally.

words.ex: The beach has sandy soil.
words.ex_cn: 这个海滩有含沙的土壤。
words.en: Covered with or consisting mostly of sand.

words.tr: v. 允许；留出；给予；承认；
words.ex: My parents allow me to go out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母允许我周末外出。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: The clock struck midnight.
words.ex_cn: 钟敲响了午夜。
words.en: Midnight is twelve o'clock in the middle of the night.

words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.tr: phrase. 大事；至关重要的事物；了不起（反语）
words.ex: It's not a big deal if you're late.
words.ex_cn: 你迟到了也没什么大不了的。
words.en: If you say that something is a big deal, you mean that it is important or significant in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.ex: I get on with my brother very well.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥相处得很好。
words.en: To continue doing something, especially after an interruption, or to have a good relationship with someone.

words.ex: There is a clear relation between exercise and health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间有明显的关联。
words.en: A relation between two things is a connection or link between them.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.tr: v. 指出；表明；争论；争辩；
words.ex: He argued that the plan was too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他指出这个计划太昂贵了。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

words.ex: The cloud floats high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 云朵在天空中飘浮。
words.en: A cloud is a visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere, typically high above the ground.

words.tr:
adj. 年长的；
n. 长者；
words.ex: My elder brother works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我年长的哥哥是一名老师。
words.en: An elder is a person who is older than you, especially one who is respected for their wisdom and experience.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do one thing instead of another, you do the first thing and not the second thing, especially as the result of a choice or a change of behaviour.

words.tr: pron. 无论什么；任何事物；
words.ex: You can eat whatever you want.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你想吃的东西。
words.en: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type; used especially when you are indicating that you do not know or care which specific thing is being referred to.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的；神经系统的；
words.ex: He felt nervous before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张不安。
words.en: If someone is nervous, they are frightened or worried about something that is happening or might happen, and show this in their behavior.

words.tr:
v. 提供；
n. 提供；提议；报价；
words.ex: He offers help to his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他向同学提供帮助。
words.en: If you offer something to someone, you ask them if they would like to have it or use it.

words.tr: adj. 正确的；合适的；正当的；
words.ex: This is the proper way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决这个问题的正确方法。
words.en: If something is proper, it is suitable or correct for a particular purpose, situation, or person.

words.ex: First, we need to eat; secondly, we need to study.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要吃饭；其次，我们需要学习。
words.en: You use secondly in speech or writing when you want to make a second point or give a second reason for something.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.ex: Can you explain this math problem?
words.ex_cn: 你能解释一下这个数学问题吗？
words.en: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很清楚。
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.tr:
n. 副本；(书，报纸等的) 一本；复制品；
v. 复制；
words.ex: Please give me a copy of the report.
words.ex_cn: 请给我一份报告的副本。
words.en: A copy is a thing made to be similar or identical to another. As a verb, to copy means to make a similar or identical version of something.

words.tr:
n. 返回；归还；
v. 返回；归还；
words.ex: The return of the train was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 火车的返回被推迟了。
words.en: To go or come back to a place or person. To give, send, or put something back to its original place or condition.

words.ex: I don't like coffee anymore.
words.ex_cn: 我不再喜欢咖啡了。
words.en: If something does not happen or is not true anymore, it has stopped happening or is no longer true.

words.ex: He is a member of the school club.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校俱乐部的成员。
words.en: A member is a person who belongs to a group such as a club, organization, or team.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.tr: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；
words.ex: This is a typical example of a sunny day.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个晴天的典型例子。
words.en: You use typical to describe someone or something that shows the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing, and is therefore a good example of that type.

words.ex: He plays football with his friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友踢足球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of eleven players with a round ball that may not be touched with the hands or arms during play except by the goalkeepers. The object of the game is to score goals by kicking or heading the ball into the opponents' goal.

words.ex: He cut out sugar from his diet.
words.ex_cn: 他从饮食中戒掉了糖。
words.en: To remove something by cutting it or to stop doing something.

words.ex: He gave a quick answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了一个快速的回答。
words.en: Moving fast or doing something in a short time.

words.ex: He will continue walking after the break.
words.ex_cn: 休息后他会继续走路。
words.en: If someone or something continues to do something, they keep doing it and do not stop.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.tr: phrase. 将……与……进行比较（通常用于强调两者之间的相似或不同之处）
words.ex: We compare apples with oranges to see the differences.
words.ex_cn: 我们把苹果和橙子进行比较，看看有什么不同。
words.en: To examine the similarities or differences between two or more things.

words.ex: He wore a crazy hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶疯狂的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as crazy, you mean that they are very enthusiastic or excited about something.

words.tr:
v. 逼迫；推；
n. 推；奋力；
words.ex: The teacher pushed the student to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师逼迫学生完成作业。
words.en: To exert force against (someone or something) in order to move them away from oneself or the origin of the force.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.tr: adj. 通常的；寻常的；惯常的；
words.ex: He takes the usual bus to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通常坐这路公交车去上班。
words.en: If something is usual, it happens most often or was most often the case in the past.

words.ex: In my opinion, the movie is very good.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这部电影非常好。
words.en: Used to express someone's personal view or belief about something.

words.ex: Perhaps it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 或许明天会下雨。
words.en: You use perhaps to express uncertainty, for example, when you do not know that something is definitely true, or when you are mentioning something that may possibly happen in the future in the way you describe.

words.tr: n. 凯茜（女子名，Catherine的昵称）；
words.ex: Cathy is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 凯茜是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A common female given name, a variant of Catherine, meaning 'pure'.

words.ex: Taylor is writing a letter to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 泰勒正在给她的朋友写信。
words.en: A common unisex given name, of Old English origin, meaning 'to cut' or 'tailor'.

words.ex: The rainstorm came suddenly last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚暴雨突然来了。
words.en: A rainstorm is a storm with heavy rain.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.ex: The firework went off at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在午夜爆炸了。
words.en: If a device or alarm goes off, it starts to ring loudly or make a loud noise. To leave a place, especially in order to do something. To happen in a particular way. To stop liking someone or something. To explode or fire. To decay or become rotten.

words.ex: He begins his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: To start doing something; to take the first step into a process or activity.

words.ex: It rained heavily last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚雨下得很大。
words.en: To a great degree; in large amounts.

words.ex: Suddenly, the light went out.
words.ex_cn: 突然，灯灭了。
words.en: If something happens suddenly, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: He picked up the phone when it rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他接了电话。
words.en: To answer or respond to a telephone call.

words.ex: He wore a strange hat to school.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去学校。
words.en: If something is strange, it is unusual or unexpected, and makes you feel slightly nervous or afraid.

words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨在夜间爆发了。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈地吹过树木。
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.ex: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
words.en: A window is a space in the wall of a building or in the side of a vehicle, which has glass in it so that light can pass through and people can see out.

words.ex: He uses a flashlight to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A flashlight is a small portable electric light that is powered by batteries and typically has a handle for holding.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.tr:
v. 打；敲打；击败；
n. 一击；跳动；
words.ex: He beat the drum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他用力敲打鼓。
words.en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, election, or battle; to hit someone or something many times with your hand, a stick, etc.

words.tr: prep. 反对；与…相反；倚着；违反；碰；对着；
words.ex: He spoke against the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: In opposition to; contrary to; in contact with.

words.ex: The baby is asleep in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在婴儿床里睡着了。
words.en: If someone is asleep, they are sleeping.

words.ex: He falls asleep quickly after turning off the light.
words.ex_cn: 他关灯后很快就睡着了。
words.en: To begin to sleep.

words.tr: phrase. 渐渐消失；平息；变弱
words.ex: The wind will die down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 风在晚上会逐渐减弱。
words.en: If something dies down, it becomes much less noticeable or active.

words.tr:
n. 上升；提高；
v. 上升；提高；
words.ex: There was a rise in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度上升了。
words.en: If an amount or level rises, it increases; if something rises, it moves upwards; if you rise, you stand up; if you rise, you get out of bed.

words.tr: v. 下降；跌倒；“fall”的过去分词； adj. 落下的；
words.ex: The leaf fallen from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 叶子从树上落了下来。
words.en: Having dropped or come down from a higher place, often used to describe leaves, snow, or someone's moral state.

words.ex: The two houses are apart by fifty meters.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子相隔五十米。
words.en: If people or things are apart, they are separated by a distance.

words.ex: I have a look at the book.
words.ex_cn: 我看了看这本书。
words.en: To take a brief look at something.

words.ex: Her icy smile made him feel cold.
words.ex_cn: 她冰冷的微笑让他感到寒意。
words.en: If you describe something as icy, you mean that it is extremely cold.

words.tr:
n. 小孩；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: The kid is playing with a ball.
words.ex_cn: 小孩在玩球。
words.en: A kid is a child or young person. As a verb, to kid means to tease or deceive someone in a playful way.

words.ex: He finally realize his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: If you realize that something is true, you become aware of that fact or understand it.

words.tr: phrase. 前往；费力前进；取得成功；闯出一条路
words.ex: The boy makes his way to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩每天早上步行去上学。
words.en: To move or travel towards a destination, especially when this is difficult or takes a long time.

words.tr: n. 通过；通道；段落；短文；
words.ex: The passage of the train through the tunnel was quick.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过隧道的速度很快。
words.en: A passage is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.ex: He completely forgot his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他完全忘记了钥匙。
words.en: In a way that is whole or entire; to the fullest extent.

words.tr: adj. 震惊的；震撼的； v. “shock”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was shocked when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他感到震惊。
words.en: If you are shocked by something, you feel very surprised and upset because of it.

words.ex: There was silence after the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 坏消息传来后，一片沉默。
words.en: The absence of sound; complete quiet.

words.ex: He sat in silence while the teacher spoke.
words.ex_cn: 老师讲话时，他静静地坐着。
words.en: Without speaking or making any noise.

words.ex: I recently bought a new book.
words.ex_cn: 我最近买了一本新书。
words.en: If something happened recently, it happened only a short time ago.

words.tr: phrase. 拆卸；拆毁；记录；记下；笔录；取下
words.ex: He took down the old photo from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上的旧照片取了下来。
words.en: To write something down, especially in order to remember or record it; to remove something from a high position; to dismantle or disassemble something.

words.ex: The police caught the terrorist near the station.
words.ex_cn: 警察在车站附近抓住了这名恐怖分子。
words.en: A terrorist is a person who uses violent and intimidating methods in the pursuit of political aims.

words.tr:
n. 日期；年代；约会；枣子；枣椰树；
v. 标日期；约会；追溯到；过时；
words.ex: What is the date today?
words.ex_cn: 今天是几号？
words.en: A date is a specific day of the month or year, which can be identified by a particular name or number.

words.tr:
n. 塔；塔楼；
v. 高耸；
words.ex: The tower stands tall in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座塔矗立在城市中心。
words.en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, either part of a larger building such as a church or castle, or standing alone.

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.ex: The truth is that he was late for work.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他上班迟到了。
words.en: The truth is the true facts about something, rather than what is imagined or invented.

words.ex: Allen is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 艾伦正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A common male given name, of Old English origin, meaning 'noble' or 'of noble birth'.

words.ex: Martin is my neighbor who loves gardening.
words.ex_cn: 马丁是我的邻居，他喜欢园艺。
words.en: A common male given name.

words.tr: n. 亚拉巴马州（美国南部的一个州）
words.ex: He lives in Alabama.
words.ex_cn: 他住在阿拉巴马州。
words.en: A state in the southeastern region of the United States, known for its rich history, diverse culture, and beautiful natural landscapes.

words.tr: phrase. 动物救助热线；为动物保护或救助提供咨询和帮助的电话服务
words.ex: She called the animal helpline to save a stray dog.
words.ex_cn: 她打电话给动物救助热线来救助一只流浪狗。
words.en: A telephone service or organization that provides assistance, advice, or rescue for animals in distress.

words.tr: phrase. 世界贸易中心（通常指美国纽约的世贸中心，或泛指全球各地的国际贸易中心建筑群）
words.ex: The world trade center was destroyed in 2001.
words.ex_cn: 世界贸易中心在2001年被摧毁。
words.en: The World Trade Center was a complex of seven buildings in Lower Manhattan, New York City, which was destroyed in the September 11 attacks in 2001.

words.ex: The soldier shoot at the target.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向目标射击。
words.en: To shoot means to fire a bullet from a gun or to take a photograph. It can also refer to the act of a plant sprouting or a player attempting to score in sports by sending the ball or puck towards the goal.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.ex: He believes in God.
words.ex_cn: 他相信上帝。
words.en: In monotheistic religions, God is the supreme being, creator, and principal object of faith.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.tr: n. 少许；小块；片刻； v. “bite”的过去式；
words.ex: Can you give me a bit of sugar?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我一点点糖吗？
words.en: A bit is a small piece or quantity of something.

words.ex: I understand a little bit of English.
words.ex_cn: 我懂一点点英语。
words.en: A small amount or to a small extent; somewhat.

words.ex: His silly hat made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他那可笑的帽子让大家都笑了。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is silly, you mean that they are foolish, childish, or ridiculous.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.tr:
v. 转变；转动；转弯；转身；
n. 转变；轮到的机会；
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在你离开前关掉灯。
words.en: To move or cause to move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis or point.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.tr:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；
n. 兽皮；
words.ex: He hides the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: To conceal something or someone from view or discovery.

words.ex: The dog wagged its tail happily.
words.ex_cn: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。
words.en: The tail of an animal, bird, or fish is the part extending beyond the end of its body.

words.tr:
n. 魔术；魔法；
adj. 魔术（似）的；神奇的；
words.ex: He performed magic at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日聚会上表演了魔术。
words.en: Magic is the power to use supernatural forces to make impossible things happen, such as making people disappear or controlling events in nature.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.ex: The kids get excited when they see the clown.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到小丑时会兴奋起来。
words.en: To excite someone means to cause them to feel very enthusiastic and eager.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.tr: phrase. 从前（用于童话故事开头）
words.ex: Once upon a time, there was a movie called 'Once Upon in Beijing'.
words.ex_cn: 从前，有一部电影叫《京城往事》。
words.en: A phrase used to introduce a story, especially a fairy tale, indicating that the events happened in the past.

words.tr: n. （继父与其前妻或继母与其前夫所生的）姐姐，妹妹
words.ex: My stepsister eats breakfast with me every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的继姐每天早上和我一起吃早餐。
words.en: A stepsister is a daughter of one's stepparent by a previous partner.

words.ex: The prince rode a white horse through the castle gate.
words.ex_cn: 王子骑着一匹白马穿过城堡的大门。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially the son of a king or queen.

words.tr: 短语动词. 爱上某人；坠入爱河
words.ex: They fall in love at school.
words.ex_cn: 他们在学校里相爱了。
words.en: To begin to feel love or a very strong liking for someone.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫很合我的身。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天微笑。
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.ex: They will marry next summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在明年夏天结婚。
words.en: To marry someone means to become their husband or wife in a legal or religious ceremony.

words.ex: They got married last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年夏天结婚了。
words.en: To enter into the state of matrimony; to become husband and wife.

words.tr:
n. 金；金币；金黄色；
adj. 金色的；
words.ex: He bought a gold ring for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为妻子买了一枚金戒指。
words.en: Gold is a valuable, yellow-colored metal that is used for making jewelry and as an international currency.

words.ex: The emperor ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位皇帝统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A male sovereign ruler of an empire.

words.ex: She wears a silk dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件丝绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A fine, strong, soft, lustrous fiber produced by silkworms in making cocoons and collected to make thread and fabric.

words.ex: He bought new underwear for the summer.
words.ex_cn: 他为夏天买了新的内衣。
words.en: Clothing worn next to the skin under outer clothes.

words.ex: Nobody knows the answer.
words.ex_cn: 没有人知道答案。
words.en: Nobody means not any person or no person.

words.ex: He made a stupid mistake on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一个愚蠢的错误。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is stupid, you mean that they show a lack of good judgment or intelligence and they are not at all sensible.

words.ex: He cheated on the test by copying answers.
words.ex_cn: 他通过抄答案来作弊。
words.en: To cheat means to act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game or examination.

words.ex: Her stepmother gave her a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 她的继母送了她一份生日礼物。
words.en: A stepmother is a woman who is married to one's father after the divorce or death of one's mother.

words.ex: He bought a flower for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的妻子买了一朵花。
words.en: A wife is a married woman considered in relation to her husband.

words.ex: Her husband cooks dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 她的丈夫每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A married man considered in relation to his spouse.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.ex: The scene at the park was peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 公园里的场景很宁静。
words.en: A scene is a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time.

words.tr:
n. 月光
v. 兼职；（尤在夜间）从事第二职业
words.ex: She works as a waitress at night to moonlight.
words.ex_cn: 她晚上当服务员来兼职。
words.en: The light that comes from the moon at night.

words.ex: The sun shines brightly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早晨明亮地发光。
words.en: To emit or reflect light brightly; to be very good at something.

words.tr: adj. 明亮的；鲜艳的；聪明的；
words.ex: The room is bright because of the big window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间因为大窗户而很明亮。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting much light; shining.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地面上玩耍。
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.tr:
n. 声音；意见；
v. 表达；
words.ex: I heard a loud voice from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来很大的声音。
words.en: Your voice is the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

words.ex: The brave firefighter saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的消防员从火中救出了孩子。
words.en: Someone who is brave is willing to do things which are dangerous, and does not show fear in difficult or dangerous situations.

words.ex: Claudia walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 克劳迪娅每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: A female given name of Latin origin, meaning 'lame' or 'enclosure'.

words.tr: phrase. 《西游记》（中国古典四大名著之一，讲述唐僧师徒四人西天取经的神魔故事）
words.ex: He is reading Journey to the West.
words.ex_cn: 他正在读《西游记》。
words.en: Journey to the West is a Chinese novel published in the 16th century during the Ming dynasty and attributed to Wu Cheng'en. It is one of the Four Great Classical Novels of Chinese literature. The novel is a fictionalized account of the legendary pilgrimage to India of the Buddhist monk Xuanzang, and his three disciples, the Monkey King, Pigsy, and Sandy.

words.tr: phrase. 美猴王（中国古典小说《西游记》中的主角孙悟空的称号）
words.ex: The monkey king can fly and fight with a magic stick.
words.ex_cn: 美猴王会飞，能用一根魔法棒战斗。
words.en: The Monkey King is a central character in the classic Chinese novel 'Journey to the West', known for his intelligence, strength, and magical abilities.

words.tr: phrase. 睡美人（童话故事中的公主角色）
words.ex: The princess is sleeping beauty in the fairy tale.
words.ex_cn: 公主在童话里是睡美人。
words.en: A fairy tale character who is a beautiful princess put into a deep sleep by a curse and awakened by a prince's kiss.

words.ex: The little girl dressed up as Cinderella for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 这个小女孩万圣节打扮成灰姑娘。
words.en: A girl in a fairy tale who is mistreated by her stepmother and stepsisters but who marries a prince with the help of a fairy godmother.

words.tr: phrase. 小红帽（欧洲童话中戴着红色斗篷的小女孩，常被用来指代天真或易受欺骗的人）
words.ex: Little Red Riding Hood walks to her grandma's house.
words.ex_cn: 小红帽走向她奶奶的家。
words.en: Little Red Riding Hood is a character in a European fairy tale about a young girl and a Big Bad Wolf.

words.tr: phrase. 《汉赛尔与格蕾特》（德国童话故事，讲述兄妹二人在森林中遭遇巫婆的小屋并最终逃脱的冒险故事）
words.ex: Hansel and Gretel walked in the forest and found a candy house.
words.ex_cn: 汉塞尔和格蕾特走进森林，发现了一座糖果屋。
words.en: Hansel and Gretel is a fairy tale about two young children who are abandoned in the forest by their parents and encounter a witch living in a house made of candy.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.tr: n. 米；公尺；仪表；计量仪；
words.ex: The table is two meters long.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子两米长。
words.en: A meter is a unit of length in the metric system, equal to 100 centimeters. It can also refer to a device that measures and records the quantity, degree, or rate of something, such as electricity or gas.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.ex: He travels to Asia every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去亚洲旅行。
words.en: Asia is the largest of the world's continents, covering approximately 30 percent of the Earth's land area. It is also the world's most populous continent, with roughly 60 percent of the total population.

words.tr: 短语. 随意的；请便；不用拘束
words.ex: Feel free to ask me any question.
words.ex_cn: 随时问我任何问题。
words.en: If you feel free to do something, you do not hesitate to do it because you feel it is acceptable or appropriate.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.ex: He paints the wall blue.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙涂成蓝色。
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built the pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人建造了金字塔。
words.en: Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.tr:
adj. 广泛的；宽的；宽阔的；
adv. 广大地；
words.ex: The book has wide use in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side to the other.

words.ex: As far as I know, he lives in New York.
words.ex_cn: 据我所知，他住在纽约。
words.en: According to the information that I have.

words.ex: The lake is a man-made pond.
words.ex_cn: 这个湖是一个人工池塘。
words.en: Made or caused by human beings rather than occurring naturally.

words.ex: He felt proud of his academic achievement.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的学业成就感到自豪。
words.en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The restaurant serves southwestern food.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供西南风味的食物。
words.en: Southwestern means in or from the southwest part of a place or country.

words.ex: The book has a thick cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有厚厚的封面。
words.en: Having a large distance between the top and bottom or front and back surfaces; not thin.

words.ex: The package includes a free book.
words.ex_cn: 这个套餐包括一本免费的书。
words.en: If one thing includes another, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

words.tr: adj. 极冷的；冰冻的； v. 结冰；冻结；“freeze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The weather is freezing today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气极冷。
words.en: If you say that something is freezing, you are emphasizing that it is very cold.

words.ex: His condition improved after the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他的状况在接受治疗后好转了。
words.en: A condition is a state of affairs that must exist or be brought about before something else can happen or be done.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: He stayed calm in the face of danger.
words.ex_cn: 他在危险面前保持冷静。
words.en: If you do something in the face of a particular situation, you do it despite the difficulties or problems that the situation causes.

words.tr: v. 完成；实现；达到；获得；
words.ex: He worked hard to achieve his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以完成他的目标。
words.en: To achieve something means to reach a particular goal or result through effort, skill, or courage.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.ex: I will go for a walk even if it rains.
words.ex_cn: 即使下雨，我也会去散步。
words.en: You use 'even if' to say that something is true or happens although something else might prevent it.

words.ex: The ocean is very big and deep.
words.ex_cn: 海洋非常大且深。
words.en: The vast body of salt water that covers almost three quarters of the earth's surface.

words.ex: The Pacific Ocean is very big.
words.ex_cn: 太平洋非常大。
words.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions, extending from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean in the south and bounded by Asia and Australia in the west and the Americas in the east.

words.ex: Curium, or Cm, is a radioactive element used in scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 锔，符号为Cm，是一种用于科学研究的放射性元素。
words.en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre.

words.ex: The pencil is 15 centimeters long.
words.ex_cn: 这支铅笔有15厘米长。
words.en: A centimeter is a unit of length in the metric system equal to one hundredth of a meter.

words.ex: The pencil is 15 centimetres long.
words.ex_cn: 这支铅笔长15厘米。
words.en: A centimetre is a unit of length in the metric system equal to one hundredth of a metre.

words.ex: The doctor will weigh the baby at the clinic.
words.ex_cn: 医生将在诊所称量婴儿的体重。
words.en: To weigh something means to measure how heavy it is, usually by using scales. It can also mean to consider something carefully before making a decision.

words.ex: His birth was in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: The emergence of a baby or other young from the body of its mother; the start of life as a physically separate being.

words.ex: He weighed 3.5 kg at birth.
words.ex_cn: 他出生时体重为3.5公斤。
words.en: At the time when a baby is born.

words.tr: phrase. 多达；直到；在于…；能胜任
words.ex: The box can hold up to ten books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子最多能放十本书。
words.en: used to say that something is the responsibility of someone or that someone has the ability to decide something

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.ex: He made a basket from bamboo.
words.ex_cn: 他用竹子做了一个篮子。
words.en: Bamboo is a tall tropical plant with hard, hollow stems. The young shoots of the plant can be eaten and the stems are used to make furniture.

words.tr: adj. 濒临灭绝的；有灭绝危险的； v. “endanger”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The panda is an endangered animal.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫是一种濒临灭绝的动物。
words.en: An animal or plant that is endangered is in danger of becoming extinct.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.ex: The zoo keeper feeds the lions every morning.
words.ex_cn: 动物园饲养员每天早上喂狮子。
words.en: A keeper is someone whose job is to look after a particular place or thing.

words.ex: He stayed awake all night to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚醒着完成作业。
words.en: If you are awake, you are not sleeping. If you awake, you wake up.

words.ex: The children felt excitement before the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在生日派对前感到兴奋。
words.en: A feeling of great enthusiasm and eagerness.

words.tr: phrase. 走进；走路时撞上；不意落入
words.ex: He walk into the room and say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他走进房间并打了声招呼。
words.en: To enter a place by walking, often used to describe entering a room, building, or area in a casual or unintentional manner.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 跌倒；被绊倒；翻倒
words.ex: The boy falls over and cries.
words.ex_cn: 男孩摔倒了，哭了。
words.en: To fall over means to fall to the ground or to fall down from an upright position.

words.ex: He is ten years old, or so.
words.ex_cn: 他十岁左右。
words.en: Approximately; used to indicate an estimate or rough quantity.

words.ex: He stayed home because of illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: An illness is a particular disease, especially one that is not very serious.

words.tr: adj. 野生的；狂热的；荒芜的；猛烈的；
words.ex: The lion is a wild animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种野生动物。
words.en: Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

words.ex: The government provides free education.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供免费教育。
words.en: The group of people who officially control a country or the system used for controlling a country.

words.ex: The whale swims deep in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲸在海洋深处游动。
words.en: A whale is a very large mammal that lives in the sea.

words.ex: She put oil on the pan before cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她在锅里倒了油再做饭。
words.en: Oil is a liquid that is used as a fuel and for lubricating the moving parts of machines.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection to his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: Protection is the act of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected.

words.ex: The dog is huge.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很大。
words.en: Extremely large in size or amount.

words.tr: 专有名词，丹增·诺尔盖（尼泊尔夏尔巴登山家，1953年与埃德蒙·希拉里爵士首次成功登顶珠穆朗玛峰）
words.ex: Tenzing Norgay climbed Mount Everest with Edmund Hillary.
words.ex_cn: 丹增·诺尔盖与埃德蒙·希拉里一起登上了珠穆朗玛峰。
words.en: Tenzing Norgay was a Nepalese Sherpa mountaineer who, along with Sir Edmund Hillary, was one of the first two individuals confirmed to have reached the summit of Mount Everest, which they did on May 29, 1953.

words.tr: 专有名词。埃德蒙·希拉里，新西兰登山家，首位成功登顶珠穆朗玛峰的人之一
words.ex: Edmund Hillary climbed Mount Everest in 1953.
words.ex_cn: 埃德蒙·希拉里在1953年登上了珠穆朗玛峰。
words.en: Edmund Hillary was a New Zealand mountaineer, explorer, and philanthropist. On 29 May 1953, Hillary and Nepalese Sherpa mountaineer Tenzing Norgay became the first climbers confirmed to have reached the summit of Mount Everest.

words.tr: phrase. 田部井淳子（首位登顶珠穆朗玛峰的女性，日本登山家）
words.ex: Junko Tabei climbed Mount Everest.
words.ex_cn: 田部井淳子登上了珠穆朗玛峰。
words.en: Junko Tabei was a Japanese mountaineer, author, and teacher. She was the first woman to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

words.tr: phrase. 珠穆朗玛峰（世界最高峰，位于中国与尼泊尔边境）
words.ex: He climbed Mount Everest last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年登上了珠穆朗玛峰。
words.en: Mount Everest is the Earth's highest mountain above sea level, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas. The China–Nepal border runs across its summit point.

words.tr: phrase. 尼罗河（非洲东北部的主要河流，世界最长河流）
words.ex: The Nile flows through Egypt.
words.ex_cn: 尼罗河流经埃及。
words.en: The Nile is a major north-flowing river in northeastern Africa, generally regarded as the longest river in the world.

words.tr: phrase. 里海（世界最大的咸水湖，位于欧洲与亚洲交界处）
words.ex: The fisherman sails on the Caspian Sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫在里海航行。
words.en: The Caspian Sea is the largest enclosed inland body of water on Earth by area, variously classed as the world's largest lake or a full-fledged sea.

words.tr: phrase. 撒哈拉沙漠（世界最大的热沙漠，位于非洲北部）
words.ex: The Sahara is a very big desert.
words.ex_cn: 撒哈拉是一个非常大的沙漠。
words.en: The Sahara is the world's largest hot desert, covering much of North Africa.

words.ex: The Yangtze River flows through many cities.
words.ex_cn: 长江流经许多城市。
words.en: The Yangtze River is the longest river in Asia and the third longest in the world, flowing through China from its source in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau to the East China Sea.

words.tr: phrase. 黄河（中国第二长河，流经多个省份，是中华文明的重要发源地）
words.ex: The Yellow River flows through northern China.
words.ex_cn: 黄河流经中国北方。
words.en: The Yellow River is the second-longest river in China and the sixth-longest in the world at the estimated length of 5,464 km.

words.tr: phrase. 明朝（1368-1644 年间的中国朝代）
words.ex: The Ming Dynasty built the Great Wall.
words.ex_cn: 明朝修建了长城。
words.en: The Ming Dynasty was the ruling dynasty of China for 276 years (1368–1644) following the collapse of the Mongol-led Yuan Dynasty.

words.ex: Many tourists visit the Great Wall every year.
words.ex_cn: 每年许多游客参观长城。
words.en: The Great Wall refers to the ancient Chinese fortifications built to protect and consolidate territories of Chinese states and empires against various nomadic groups of the steppe and their polities.

words.tr: phrase. 喜马拉雅山脉（位于亚洲，世界最高山脉）
words.ex: The Himalayas are very high mountains.
words.ex_cn: 喜马拉雅山是很高的山脉。
words.en: The Himalayas is a mountain range in Asia, separating the plains of the Indian subcontinent from the Tibetan Plateau. It includes the highest peaks on Earth, including Mount Everest.

words.tr: phrase. 亚马逊河（世界流量最大的河流，位于南美洲）
words.ex: The amazon river flows through Brazil.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊河穿过巴西流淌。
words.en: The Amazon River in South America is the largest river by discharge volume of water in the world, and by some definitions it is the longest.

words.tr: 专有名词，指位于中国四川省成都市的大熊猫繁育研究基地，致力于大熊猫的保护、研究与繁育工作
words.ex: The panda cubs live in the Chengdu research base.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫幼崽生活在成都研究基地。
words.en: A specific research facility in Chengdu, China, dedicated to the study and conservation of giant pandas and other endangered species.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

words.ex: He lives on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个小岛上。
words.en: An island is a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water.

words.ex: The room is full of toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间充满了玩具。
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.ex: The newspaper has ten pages.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸有十版。
words.en: A page is one side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, newspaper, or other collection of bound sheets.

words.tr:
n. 匆忙；
v. 赶快；
words.ex: He left in a hurry without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙离开，连再见都没说。
words.en: If you hurry somewhere, you go there quickly. If you hurry to do something, you start doing it quickly or do it more quickly than usual.

words.ex: Hurry up, or we will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则我们会错过公交车。
words.en: If you tell someone to hurry up, you are telling them to do something more quickly than they were doing it.

words.tr: adj. 应给的；预期的；到期的；
words.ex: The payment is due tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这笔款项明天应给。
words.en: If something is due at a particular time, it is expected to happen or be done at that time.

words.tr:
n. 船；舰；
v. 装运；
words.ex: The ship sailed across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 船驶过了海洋。
words.en: A ship is a large boat for travelling on water, especially across the sea.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是修理东西的有用工具。
words.en: A tool is any instrument or simple piece of equipment that you hold in your hands and use to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: The policeman held a gun.
words.ex_cn: 警察拿着一把枪。
words.en: A gun is a weapon designed to discharge projectiles, often metal bullets, by the force of an explosive such as gunpowder.

words.tr:
n. 记号；分数；痕迹；
v. 做标记；（使）留痕迹；评分；
words.ex: He put a mark on the map to show the place.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图上做了一个记号来表示那个地方。
words.en: A mark is a small area or spot on a surface which is different in colour or texture from the area around it. If you mark something, you make a mark on it in order to identify it or to give information about it.

words.ex: The children built a castle in the sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在沙子里建了一座城堡。
words.en: Sand is a substance that consists of very small grains of rock, found on beaches and in deserts.

words.tr: n. 食人肉者；同类相食的动物
words.ex: The legend says the cannibal ate his enemy.
words.ex_cn: 传说这个食人肉者吃掉了他的敌人。
words.en: A cannibal is a person who eats the flesh of other human beings.

words.ex: He walked towards the park.
words.ex_cn: 他朝公园走去。
words.en: In the direction of; with a tendency to; in relation to; for the purpose of.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.ex: He likes to read science fiction books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Science fiction is a genre of speculative fiction that typically deals with imaginative and futuristic concepts such as advanced science and technology, space exploration, time travel, parallel universes, and extraterrestrial life. It has been called the 'literature of ideas', and often explores the potential consequences of scientific, social, and technological innovations.

words.ex: New technology helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助农民种植更多的粮食。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.tr:
adj. 法国的；法国人的；法语的；
n. 法语；法国人；
words.ex: She ate french bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了法国面包。
words.en: relating to France, its people, or its language

words.tr:
n. 流行音乐；
v. 发出砰的一声；突然地行动；
words.ex: I love listening to pop on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在收音机里听流行音乐。
words.en: To make a short, sharp, explosive sound; to appear suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.ex: He listens to country music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听乡村音乐。
words.en: A genre of popular music that originated in the rural regions of the Southern United States, blending traditional folk music with elements of blues and gospel.

words.ex: He loves his country and wants to serve it.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱自己的国家，想要为它服务。
words.en: A country is a region identified as a distinct entity in political geography.

words.ex: I will love you forever.
words.ex_cn: 我会永远爱你。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or continue forever, you mean that it will always happen or continue.

words.ex: He went abroad to study medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他去国外学医。
words.en: In or to a foreign country or countries.

words.tr: adv. 事实上；实际上；竟然；
words.ex: I thought he was late, but actually he was on time.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上他准时到了。
words.en: You use actually to indicate that a situation exists or happened, or to emphasize that it is true.

words.ex: He has been happy ever since he moved to the city.
words.ex_cn: 自从他搬到城市以来，他一直很快乐。
words.en: From a particular time in the past until the present.

words.ex: He is a big fan of soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他是足球的忠实粉丝。
words.en: A fan is a device that creates a current of air by the movement of its blades. It is also used to refer to a person who has a strong interest in and admiration for a particular person or thing.

words.ex: He lives in the southern part of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城市的南部。
words.en: Located in or characteristic of a region in the south.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.tr: phrase. 另外一个人；彼此；相互
words.ex: The students helped one another with their homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们互相帮助做作业。
words.en: used to indicate that each of two or more people or things does something to or with the other(s)

words.ex: The children's laughter filled the room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的笑声充满了房间。
words.en: The sound of people laughing, especially when it is loud and continuous.

words.tr: n. 美；美的事物；美丽；美人；
words.ex: The beauty of the sunset amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 日落的美让所有人都惊叹。
words.en: Beauty is the quality of being pleasing, especially to look at, or someone or something that gives great pleasure, especially when you look at it.

words.tr:
num. 一百万；
n. 百万；百万个；
words.ex: There are a million stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有百万颗星星。
words.en: A million is the number 1,000,000.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.ex: He will introduce his friend to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班介绍他的朋友。
words.en: If you introduce someone, you tell someone else their name so that they can know each other.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.ex: Alex plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 亚历克斯每周末都踢足球。
words.en: A male given name, often short for Alexander.

words.tr: 专有名词，加斯·布鲁克斯（美国著名乡村音乐歌手）
words.ex: Garth Brooks sings country music very well.
words.ex_cn: 加思·布鲁克斯唱乡村音乐非常棒。
words.en: A highly successful American country music singer and songwriter.

words.tr: phrase. 披头士乐队（英国著名摇滚乐队）
words.ex: The Beatles sang many popular songs in the 1960s.
words.ex_cn: 披头士乐队在20世纪60年代演唱了许多流行歌曲。
words.en: The Beatles were an English rock band formed in Liverpool in 1960, widely regarded as the most influential band of all time.

words.tr: phrase. 宝岛；藏宝岛（常指罗伯特·路易斯·史蒂文森所著经典冒险小说《金银岛》）
words.ex: He read a book called Treasure Island last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天读了一本叫《金银岛》的书。
words.en: A novel by Robert Louis Stevenson, first published in 1883, which tells the story of pirates and buried gold.

words.tr: phrase. 爱丽丝梦游仙境（一部著名的童话故事，描述小女孩爱丽丝进入奇幻世界后的冒险经历）
words.ex: He is reading Alice in Wonderland before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡前在读《爱丽丝梦游仙境》。
words.en: Alice in Wonderland is a novel by Lewis Carroll that tells the story of a girl named Alice who falls through a rabbit hole into a fantasy world populated by peculiar and anthropomorphic creatures.

words.tr: phrase. 《小妇人》（美国作家路易莎·梅·奥尔科特的经典小说，讲述马奇家四姐妹的成长故事）
words.ex: She is reading little women before bed.
words.ex_cn: 她睡前在读《小妇人》。
words.en: Little Women is a novel by Louisa May Alcott, published in two volumes in 1868 and 1869. The novel follows the lives of the four March sisters—Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy—and details their passage from childhood to womanhood. It is loosely based on the lives of the author and her three sisters.

words.ex: Oliver Twist is a boy who lives in a workhouse.
words.ex_cn: 奥利弗·特威斯特是一个住在济贫院的男孩。
words.en: Oliver Twist is the title character and protagonist of the novel Oliver Twist by Charles Dickens, published in 1838. The story is about an orphan boy who faces many adversities but remains pure at heart.

words.ex: Robinson Crusoe lives alone on a desert island.
words.ex_cn: 鲁滨逊·克鲁索独自生活在一座荒岛上。
words.en: Robinson Crusoe is the protagonist of the novel 'Robinson Crusoe' by Daniel Defoe, which narrates the tale of a man shipwrecked and living alone on an island.

words.tr: phrase. 汤姆·索亚（美国作家马克·吐温小说《汤姆·索亚历险记》中的主人公）
words.ex: Tom Sawyer is a boy who loves adventures.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆·索亚是一个喜欢冒险的男孩。
words.en: Tom Sawyer is the protagonist of the novel 'The Adventures of Tom Sawyer' by Mark Twain, known for his adventurous spirit and mischievous behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 哈利·波特（英国作家J.K.罗琳创作的魔幻小说系列中的主角）
words.ex: He loves reading Harry Potter books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读《哈利·波特》这本书。
words.en: Harry Potter is the protagonist of the Harry Potter series of novels written by British author J.K. Rowling.

words.tr: n. 纳什维尔（美国田纳西州首府）
words.ex: He lives in Nashville with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在纳什维尔。
words.en: Nashville is the capital city of the U.S. state of Tennessee, known for its vibrant music scene, especially country music.

words.tr: n. 田纳西州（美国东南部的一个州）
words.ex: He lives in Tennessee with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在田纳西州。
words.en: A state in the southeastern region of the United States, known for its music, especially country music, and the Great Smoky Mountains National Park.

words.w: country music hall of fame museum
words.tr: phrase. 乡村音乐名人堂博物馆
words.uk: ˌkʌntri ˈmjuːzɪk hɔːl əv ˈfeɪm mjuːˈziːəm
words.us: ˌkʌntri ˈmjuːzɪk hɔːl əv ˈfeɪm mjuːˈziːəm
words.ex: They visited the country music hall of fame museum in Nashville.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了位于纳什维尔的乡村音乐名人堂博物馆。
words.en: A museum in Nashville, Tennessee, dedicated to preserving and celebrating country music history.

words.ex: Children find amusement in playing games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在玩游戏时感到快乐。
words.en: Amusement is the feeling that you have when you think that something is funny or entertaining.

words.ex: The children went to the amusement park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们星期天去了游乐园。
words.en: An amusement park is a large outdoor area with fairground rides, shows, and other entertainments.

words.ex: I left my keys somewhere in the house.
words.ex_cn: 我把钥匙落在房子的某个地方了。
words.en: In or to some place.

words.ex: He took a photo with his camera.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的摄像机拍了一张照片。
words.en: A camera is a piece of equipment that is used for taking photographs, making films, or producing television pictures.

words.ex: The telephone was a great invention.
words.ex_cn: 电话是一项伟大的发明。
words.en: An invention is a unique or novel device, method, composition or process. It may be an improvement upon a machine or product, or a new process for creating an object or a result. An invention that achieves a completely unique function or result may be a radical breakthrough. Such works are novel and not obvious to others skilled in the same field.

words.ex: He invented a new machine to clean the house.
words.ex_cn: 他发明了一台新机器来打扫房子。
words.en: To invent something means to design or create it, especially something that has never been made before.

words.tr: adj. 难以相信的；难以置信的；
words.ex: The magic trick was unbelievable.
words.ex_cn: 那个魔术难以相信。
words.en: If you say that something is unbelievable, you are emphasizing that it is very good, impressive, intense, or extreme.

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.ex: The car moved at a rapid speed.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: A rapid change or event happens very quickly.

words.tr: adj. 不平常的；不寻常的；
words.ex: It is unusual to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不平常的。
words.en: If something is unusual, it does not happen very often or you do not see it or hear it very often.

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 马桶坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.tr: phrase. 茶艺；与泡茶、品茶相关的艺术形式
words.ex: He practices tea art every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习茶艺。
words.en: The practice or skill of preparing and serving tea in a traditional and artistic way.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: The recipe is perfect for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱对初学者来说是完备的。
words.en: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

words.tr: phrase. 茶具套装（包括茶壶、茶杯、茶碟等用于泡茶和饮茶的器具）
words.ex: She bought a new tea set for her mother.
words.ex_cn: 她为母亲买了一套新的茶具。
words.en: A tea set is a set of crockery for serving tea, typically including a teapot, cups, saucers, and sometimes a milk jug and sugar bowl.

words.ex: The dog licked itself.
words.ex_cn: 狗舔了自己。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a thing or animal previously mentioned as the subject of the clause.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周收集邮票。
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.tr:
adj. 德国的；
n. 德语；德国人；
words.ex: She speaks German music and eats German food.
words.ex_cn: 她听德国音乐，吃德国食物。
words.en: relating to Germany, its people, or their language

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.tr:
n. 骑；乘坐；
v. 骑；乘坐；
words.ex: He gave me a ride on his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他让我骑了他的自行车。
words.en: To sit on and control the movement of an animal, especially a horse, or to travel in or on a vehicle or other conveyance.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.tr:
num. 一千；
n. 千；千个；
words.ex: There are a thousand stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有一千颗星星。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of a hundred and ten; 1,000.

words.ex: Thousands of people attended the concert.
words.ex_cn: 数千人参加了这场音乐会。
words.en: A large number of something, typically more than a thousand.

words.tr: phrase. 一方面……另一方面……；用于对比或权衡两个相反或不同的观点
words.uk: ɒn ðə wʌn hænd ... ɒn ði ˈʌðə hænd ...
words.us: ɑːn ðə wʌn hænd ... ɑːn ði ˈʌðər hænd ...
words.ex: On the one hand, he wants to travel. On the other hand, he needs to save money.
words.ex_cn: 一方面，他想旅行。另一方面，他需要省钱。
words.en: Used to present two contrasting points of view or facts about something.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.ex: He simply wants to go home.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想回家。
words.en: In a simple manner; without much complexity or difficulty.

words.tr:
n. 害怕；惧怕；
v. 害怕；惧怕；
words.ex: He felt a deep fear when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，感到深深的害怕。
words.en: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

words.ex: I don't know whether he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他是否会来。
words.en: You use whether when you are talking about a choice or doubt between two or more alternatives.

words.tr:
adj. 印度的；印第安人的；
n. 印度人；印第安人；
words.ex: She cooked Indian food for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她为晚餐做了印度菜。
words.en: An Indian is a person from India or a member of one of the indigenous peoples of the Americas.

words.tr:
adj. 日本的；日本人的；日语的；
n. 日语；日本人；
words.ex: She ate Japanese food for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚餐吃了日本菜。
words.en: Relating to Japan, its people, or their language.

words.ex: The fox ran quickly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狐狸快速地跑过森林。
words.en: A fox is a wild animal which looks like a dog and has reddish-brown fur, a pointed face and ears, and a thick tail. Foxes are often described as cunning and sly.

words.tr: phrase. 一年到头； 全年
words.ex: She plays tennis all year round.
words.ex_cn: 她全年都打网球。
words.en: If something happens all year round, it happens throughout the year.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.ex: Call me whenever you need help.
words.ex_cn: 无论何时你需要帮助，就给我打电话。
words.en: at any or every time that

words.tr:
n. 春天；弹簧；泉；
v. 突然猛烈地移动；跳；
words.ex: Flowers bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天花朵盛开。
words.en: Spring is the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow again. It is also a device that returns to its original shape after being compressed or stretched, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: He is mostly late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他主要迟到上课。
words.en: You use mostly to indicate that a statement is generally true, for example true about most of a group of things or people, true most of the time, or true in most situations.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: We visited the national science museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了国家科学博物馆。
words.en: A museum dedicated to the exhibition and education of scientific knowledge and achievements.

words.tr: phrase. 国际厕所博物馆（位于印度新德里，专门收藏和展示与厕所及卫生设施相关的历史文物和资料）
words.ex: We visited the international museum of toilets in New Delhi.
words.ex_cn: 我们参观了位于新德里的国际厕所博物馆。
words.en: A museum dedicated to the history and development of toilets and sanitation systems globally.

words.tr: phrase. 杭州国家茶叶博物馆
words.ex: We visited the Hangzhou National Tea Museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了杭州中国茶叶博物馆。
words.en: The Hangzhou National Tea Museum is a museum dedicated to the history, culture, and art of tea in Hangzhou, China.

words.tr: phrase. 唐老鸭（迪士尼经典卡通人物）
words.ex: Donald Duck wears a sailor shirt and hat.
words.ex_cn: 唐老鸭穿着水手衫和帽子。
words.en: A fictional cartoon duck character created by Walt Disney, known for his sailor suit and short temper.

words.tr: n. 迪士尼乐园（美国加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆市的一个主题公园，由华特·迪士尼创建）；
words.ex: We went to Disneyland last summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们去年夏天去了迪士尼乐园。
words.en: Disneyland is a theme park in Anaheim, California, created by Walt Disney and opened in 1955. It is known for its attractions, entertainment, and characters from Disney films.

words.tr: phrase. 迪士尼邮轮（指由迪士尼公司运营的主题邮轮服务，通常包含家庭娱乐、迪士尼角色互动和加勒比海等地的航线）
words.ex: They went on a Disney cruise last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年夏天去了迪士尼邮轮。
words.en: A Disney Cruise refers to a cruise vacation experience offered by Disney Cruise Line, featuring Disney-themed entertainment, characters, and activities.

words.tr: phrase. 兵马俑；陶土制成的古代中国秦始皇陵陪葬军队雕像群
words.ex: The terracotta army guards the tomb of the first emperor.
words.ex_cn: 兵马俑守护着第一位皇帝的陵墓。
words.en: The Terracotta Army is a collection of terracotta sculptures depicting the armies of Qin Shi Huang, the first Emperor of China. It is a form of funerary art buried with the emperor in 210–209 BCE with the purpose of protecting the emperor in his afterlife.

words.ex: The bird built its nest in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在树上筑了巢。
words.en: A bird's nest is a structure built by birds to hold their eggs and provide a place for their young to develop.

words.ex: He lives in Singapore.
words.ex_cn: 他住在新加坡。
words.en: A country in Southeast Asia, known for its multicultural society, strict laws, and as a global financial hub.

words.ex: Many tourists visit southeast asia for its beaches and temples.
words.ex_cn: 许多游客去东南亚旅游，因为那里有海滩和寺庙。
words.en: Southeast Asia refers to the southeastern region of Asia, consisting of countries that are geographically south of China, east of India, west of New Guinea and north of Australia.

words.tr: phrase. 夜间野生动物园；夜间游猎
words.ex: We went on a night safari to see lions.
words.ex_cn: 我们去夜间野生动物园看狮子。
words.en: A night safari is a type of zoo that is open at night, allowing visitors to observe nocturnal animals in their natural habitat.

words.ex: The children play in the yard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在院子里玩耍。
words.en: A yard is an area of land next to a building, often with grass and plants, or a unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 meters.

words.tr: phrase. 现场出售，院子买卖
words.ex: We had a yard sale to sell old toys and books.
words.ex_cn: 我们举办了一场院子买卖，卖掉旧玩具和书。
words.en: A sale of used household belongings, typically held outdoors at the seller's residence.

words.tr:
adj. 甜的；悦人的；
n. 糖果；
words.ex: The cake is sweet and delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕又甜又美味。
words.en: Sweet is used to describe something that tastes of sugar or is pleasant in a way that is reminiscent of sugar. It can also describe something that is pleasing to the senses other than taste, such as a sound or smell, or something that is kind and gentle.

words.ex: His memory is very good; he remembers everything.
words.ex_cn: 他的记忆力很好；他什么都记得。
words.en: Memory is the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information.

words.ex: The apple costs 50 cents.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果售价50分。
words.en: A cent is a small unit of money in many countries. In the United States, a cent is equal to one hundredth of a dollar.

words.ex: The child plays with a toy car.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在玩一辆玩具汽车。
words.en: A toy is an object for children to play with.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.ex: He is a maker of wooden chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他是木椅的制造者。
words.en: A maker is a person or company that makes or produces something.

words.tr: phrase. 制作面包的人；面包机
words.ex: My grandfather is a bread maker who bakes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父是一位每天早晨都烤面包的制面包人。
words.en: A bread maker is an electric kitchen appliance for baking bread.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头很软，很舒服。
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.ex: The child hugs a soft toy every night.
words.ex_cn: 孩子每天晚上都抱着一个毛绒玩具。
words.en: A soft toy is a children's toy made of fabric stuffed with a soft material, often resembling an animal or a character.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games.
